get.summary: The served-game model menu (tested models only), and what the house will pay for
get.description:
Every tested model with its rescue, whether the house pays for it, and which one is
the default right now; plus the house's purse for today, so the client can say
"house pays, 3 left" or "your key needed" before the player submits.

post.summary: Instant start: solo human (role choice) or LLM-only
Resume a key-funded game after a restart by supplying the key again
post.description:
Any seat holder may fund the resume; spectators may not. The key is tried on the
provider first (422 with its complaint), then the game continues from its checkpoint.
409 when the game is not waiting for a key.

get.description:
Stream entitled durable events plus public ephemeral pacing frames.

``last_seq`` is the cursor frozen into the original URL. On automatic browser
reconnection, ``Last-Event-ID`` carries the live cursor and therefore wins when
valid. Pacing frames have no ID, so they never advance that durable cursor.
Return non-stale waiting rooms newest first without expiring direct URLs.

post.summary: Create a multiplayer waiting room (humans join via /join)
post.description:
Create a lobby whose identifier remains stable when the game starts.

Humans enter only through ``/join`` and roles remain random. The model is resolved
and the house consulted here so the host learns early; the cap is checked again at
start, which is when the game actually costs anything.

post.summary: Lock or unlock a waiting room (host only)
Claim a human seat in a waiting room
Restore a lost seat cookie from the token's body copy
Start the waiting room's game (host only)
post.description: Replace the lobby with a running session under the same ID (registry.start).

get.summary: One finished game's full event log
The house's purse as of now

AddressedTargetsAnnotation.title: AddressedTargetsAnnotation
AddressedTargetsAnnotation.description: Structured who-this-addresses tags. Joins the speech via about_channel_seq.

DaySummary.title: DaySummary
DaySummary.description:
Shown next morning — client render rule, no buffer (buffers gate entitlement;
render timing gates pacing).

DaySummaryStructured.title: DaySummaryStructured
DaySummaryStructured.description: O-tier structured form of the summary (accusations / role claims / alliances).

FiringReasonAnnotation.title: FiringReasonAnnotation
FiringReasonAnnotation.description: Scheduler trace for a turn: why it fired. Joins the speech/pass via about_channel_seq.

FundGame.title: FundGame
FundGame.description:
POST /games/{id}/key body: a seat holder's key to resume a game that lost its
funding in a restart. Tried on the provider before the game moves; never stored.

GameOver.title: GameOver
GameOver.description:
Thin by ruling: an entitlement flip, not a data package — the server follows it with
the withheld observer-tier backlog from the durable log.

GameStatus.title: GameStatus
GameStatus.description:
GET /games/{id} response: the poll-side snapshot (the stream carries the rest).

One shape for both registry phases — a lobby fills only the header trio
(game_id, state, players) and leaves the game fields at their defaults.

GmMessage.title: GmMessage
GmMessage.description: Verbatim GM narration (record fidelity outranks derivability for authored text).

HouseFunding.title: HouseFunding
HouseFunding.description: The house's purse for today, as GET /models reports it to the client.

HouseUpdate.title: HouseUpdate
HouseUpdate.description: PUT /admin/house body: any subset of the knobs.

HouseView.title: HouseView
HouseView.description: GET/PUT /admin/house response: the purse plus the knobs behind it.

InputRequest.title: InputRequest
InputRequest.description:
The human seat's turn prompt (interrupt surface). Night instances fire inside a
parallel superstep — resume semantics gated on the spike verification.

InvestigationResult.title: InvestigationResult
InvestigationResult.description: Survival-gated in the engine node: no committed delta -> this event never exists.

JoinGame.title: JoinGame
JoinGame.description:
POST /games/{id}/join body. No role field on purpose: rooms deal random
seats (role choice is solo-only, on the instant-start path).

LynchResult.title: LynchResult
LynchResult.description: The day death atom (= the dead_roster delta) + the free-rider fields the node computed.

ModelRow.title: ModelRow
ModelRow.description: One entry of the GET /models served-game menu.

ModelsMenu.title: ModelsMenu
ModelsMenu.description: GET /models response: the menu, and what the house will pay for right now.

NewGame.title: NewGame
NewGame.description:
POST /games body: the instant-start (solo / LLM-only) door. Multiplayer
rooms are created at POST /rooms — a deliberately separate contract.

NewRoom.title: NewRoom
NewRoom.description:
POST /rooms body: the multiplayer door. No human/role fields ON PURPOSE —
a room seats humans only via POST /join and always deals random roles, so the
concept is unrepresentable here instead of guarded; extra="forbid" turns a
client sending instant-start fields into a clean 422.

NightAction.title: NightAction
NightAction.description:
O-tier committed target of a single-target night actor. No seat ack by ruling —
the seat re-learns its act from dawn's gm_message; the live client echoes locally.

NightResult.title: NightResult
NightResult.description:
The night death atom (= the dead_roster delta) + free-riders. Empty deaths = quiet
night. Silent whiffs (immune SK) appear NOWHERE here — absence is the design.

PassMarker.title: PassMarker
PassMarker.description: A discussion turn that produced no speech — hidden from the table, observer-only.

PhaseChange.title: PhaseChange
PhaseChange.description:
Node-identity marker: anchored on initialize_game/one_more_day (day), START_VOTING
(voting), and NIGHT_START (night).

RejoinGame.title: RejoinGame
RejoinGame.description:
POST /games/{id}/rejoin body: re-prove seat ownership after cookie loss
(new device, cleared browsing data) with the stashed body-copy token.

ReplayGame.title: ReplayGame
ReplayGame.description: One complete replay with every stored event revalidated for the wire.

RoleAssigned.title: RoleAssigned
RoleAssigned.description: Seat-private deal: one per seat at game start.

RolesAssigned.title: RolesAssigned
RolesAssigned.description:
O-tier full deal at game start: nobody receives it live; exists so the game_over
backlog replay has survivor roles from minute zero.

RoomSummary.title: RoomSummary
RoomSummary.description:
One row of GET /rooms: the public face of a waiting room. Also the POST /lock
response (the host's fresh view after flipping the flag). Never any secret —
no host_key, no tokens.

RosterUpdate.title: RosterUpdate
RosterUpdate.description:
Union only: the translator merges the wolf-partitioned survivor lists before the
public tier ever sees them.

TurnStarted.title: TurnStarted
TurnStarted.description: Edge-emitted (route_speaker): who is about to speak. Not a promise of speech.

VigilanteConfirmation.title: VigilanteConfirmation
VigilanteConfirmation.description: Private immune-whiff confirmation: the shot target is the serial killer.

VoteCast.title: VoteCast
VoteCast.description: Ballot content, released as a batch at COLLECT_VOTES from the translator buffer.

WolfKillDecided.title: WolfKillDecided
WolfKillDecided.description:
The pack's plurality tally (random tiebreak) — the only way a wolf seat learns it
before dawn.

WolfMessage.title: WolfMessage
WolfMessage.description: Wolf-channel talk. wolf == "game_master" for the server-authored SK-whiff note.

WolfVote.title: WolfVote
WolfVote.description:
Binding kill vote — buffered by the translator until the tally (blind voting +
wire/state parity), then flushed together with wolf_kill_decided.
